title: Copilot Studio Developer
jobDescription: Copilot Studio Developer Copilot Studio Developer Job Description Copilot Studio Developer with 3.6 years of experience in Power Platform or conversational AI development. The role involves designing and developing AI-powered conversational agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and integrating them with enterprise systems through Power Automate, APIs, and connectors. Experience in enterprise Power Platform solutions and AI conversational systems is preferred. The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical, automation, troubleshooting, and communication skills to build scalable and efficient AI-driven enterprise solutions successfully. Requirements Responsibilities include creating conversational flows, topic routing, adaptive cards, orchestration, knowledge source integration, RAG-based responses, and implementing human-in-the-loop workflows while ensuring governance and security compliance. Candidates should have strong expertise in Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Platform development, API integrations, and conversational design. title: Lead Polyglot Developer
jobDescription:
Lead Polyglot Developer Lead Polyglot Developer Job Description This is a remote position. What you'll do ?? Work on technically challenging problems Collaborate with the team to design elegant solutions Write code that is easy to read, test, and maintain. Participate in building prototypes and showcase products Participate in the larger tech community as a speaker and represent Tarka Labs at conferences. What are we looking for? People with a growth mindset Experience in building distributed systems and demonstrating ownership of the work you’ve done. Comfortable in communicating and reaching clarity on ambiguous business requirements by talking with stakeholders. Knowledge of CS fundamentals Knowledge of the Web based UI technologies
- HTML5, CSS, React/Redux or similar modern javascript development environment Understand one of the bundling tools like Webpack, rollup, parcel or esbuild. Deep knowledge of HTTP server and writing micro services with at least one dynamic language focused on productivity like Ruby, Python or PHP with its popular framework and its ecosystem (e.g., Rails, Django, Flask, Laravel etc) Knowledge of a statically typed C family of language like C, C++, C#, Java, Scala, Go, Rust or similar Knowledge of working with an RDBMS like My SQL or Postgre SQL. Be comfortable with complex queries and understand how to read query plans and optimize the query accordingly. Basic knowledge of the linux operating system to be comfortable to SSH into and run some common operations to manage the server. Knowledge of containerization tools like docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes is preferred. Skills & Qualifications? Must be a passionate hackers, enthusiastic polyglot developers & software plumbers who work with clients to build beautiful and brilliant Digital Products and Digital Experiences. Empathize and care about client’s customers as much as they do. You will use the latest Lean and Agile thinking, create pragmatic solutions to solve mission-critical problems and challenge yourself every day. Must have a strategic mindset to projects and spend time negotiating with clients in order to bring a technical vision to life. Having a balance of high-level and tactical mindsets is a must as you will spend time both with clients and alongside your fellow teammates. Benefits 100% remote role Work Life Balance Flexible holidays Robust L&D programs :People-centric Culture/Practice Competitive package Multi-domain experience :Community contribution programs Attend Hackathons and Conferences Health Insurance Plan for Whole Family + Accidental and Life Coverages I'm interested View all jobs Visit website Powered by {{criteria Index}} {{field}} {{captialize(condition)}} ( ) {{cx Prop Help Text}} {{cx Prop Field.consent_details.description}} {{record.Posting_Title}} {{record.Posting_Title}} {{record.Posting_Title}} {{candidate.Email}} {{top Message}} Job Details {{top Message}} previous next {{title}} {{score}}% Job Description {{unescape(sanitize HTML(description HTML))}} {{message}} Step {{cur Step In Mandatory Sec Prompt}}/{{total Num Of Steps In Mandatory Sec Prompt}} For privacy and security purposes, please go through the following points and provide consent. title: Odoo Pre Sales
jobDescription: Responsibilities Sales & Business Development • Identify and qualify new Odoo ERP opportunities across target i Job Description Key Responsibilities Sales & Business Development • Identify and qualify new Odoo ERP opportunities across target industries. • Engage with prospects to understand their business challenges and ERP needs. • Support lead generation, follow-ups, client meetings, and opportunity tracking. • Build strong relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. • Assist in achieving monthly and quarterly sales targets. Presales & Solution Consulting (A definite plus point) • Conduct discovery sessions with prospects to understand business processes. • Map customer requirements to relevant Odoo modules such as CRM, Sales, Purchase, Inventory, Accounting, Manufacturing, HR, POS, Website, and e Commerce. • Prepare solution presentations, proposals, demos, and commercial documents. • Coordinate with functional and technical teams for effort estimation and solution design. • Respond to RFPs, RFIs, and customer requirement documents. • Support proposal preparation including scope, timelines, commercials, and exclusions. • Work with delivery teams to ensure smooth handover after deal closure. Requirements • 3–5 years of experience in ERP sales, presales, or business development. • Good understanding of Odoo ERP and its major business modules. • Experience in selling or supporting ERP, CRM, accounting, inventory, or business automation solutions. • Ability to understand business requirements and explain solutions clearly. • Strong communication, presentation, and client-facing skills. • Experience preparing proposals, demos, and sales documentation. • Ability to coordinate between clients, sales teams, and delivery teams. • Good follow-up discipline and ownership of opportunities. • Odoo certification is good to have. ​ Preferred Skills • Experience working with Odoo partners or ERP implementation companies. • Exposure to industries such as retail, trading, manufacturing, distribution, real estate, or services. • Basic understanding of implementation lifecycle, customization, integrations, and support models. • Familiarity with CRM tools and sales pipeline tracking. • Knowledge of Odoo pricing, licensing, and partner ecosystem is an advantage. Benefits Candidate Profile • Self-driven and target-oriented. • Comfortable speaking with business owners, finance teams, operations heads, and IT teams. • Able to translate business problems into practical ERP solution narratives. • Good at documentation and structured follow-ups. • Willing to work from Chennai and collaborate with regional or international sales teams. title: Senior Control Engineer
jobDescription:
Senior Control Engineer Senior Control Engineer Job Description Job Title: Sr. Controls Engineer Location:
- Bangalore Job Type:
- Full Time Experience Level:
- 7+ Years Industry: Industrial Automation / Controls Systems / Electrical Engineering / Power Plants / Water Utilities / Oil & Gas Industries / Chemical Industries Role Description � This is a full-time hybrid role of Sr. Controls Engineer located in Bengaluru with some flexibility to work remotely. � As a Controls engineer, you will be responsible for designing and programming controls systems for industrial machinery and/or processes. � Your day-to-day tasks will include developing electrical schematics, Electrical Panel Design and component selection, Selection & programming of PLCs, working with other engineers and designers, and testing and troubleshooting systems. � The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, drafting, and supporting electrical control panels from concept through execution. � This Includes sometimes travelling to client locations in America, Canada, Europe and Gulf Countries to execute the projects onsite. Key Responsibilities � We are seeking a candidate with 8+ years of experience in Industrial controls systems with Electrical design and selection of electrical components for electrical panels, PLC systems design, Programming, planning and execution onsite. � The ideal candidate will possess deep domain expertise in PLC & HMI programming & understanding of electrical circuits & wiring and should have prior experience in Oil & Gas, Chemical, Cement, and Industrial Automation industries. � Proficient in programming PLC�s & HMI�s, including Siemens, Allen Bradley, Schneider and others, if any will be an added advantage. � Experience in designing electrical schematics and reading design drawings � Familiarity with communication protocols, such as Modbus, Ethernet/IP, Profibus, Prof Net Etc. � Understanding of industrial control systems and automation technologies � Bachelor�s or master�s degree in electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or Automation Engineering. Recruit, train, and mentor a multi-disciplinary team of engineers and technicians. � Define roles, responsibilities, KPIs, and performance metrics for the team. � Establish processes and SOPs for design, testing. � Define project scopes, timelines, budgets, and resource requirements. � Interface with clients, vendors, and cross-functional departments for smooth project execution. � Design electrical system architecture, select components, and perform load calculations. � Create power and control circuit diagrams including transformers, MCBs, MCCBs, and SMPS. � Draft panel layouts, GA drawings, and internal arrangements using Auto CAD Electrical � Design PLC and HMI wiring, insert PLC modules, and connect field devices like sensors and solenoid valves, etc. � Prepare terminal block details, cable schedules, and pin assignment drawings. � Create grounding, earthing, and communication network diagrams. � compliance with electrical standards and working proficiency � Generate cutout drawings, label/ferrule lists, and documentation for assembly. � Prepare device lists, BOMs, and support panel integration and testing. � Assign roles, monitor progress, and provide technical mentoring to junior engineers. � Act as the single POC for clients, and internal stakeholders for project delivery. � Establish documentation protocols, process templates, and engineering guidelines for consistent execution across projects. � Strong verbal/written communication and client-facing skills. � Team builder who thrives under deadlines and adapts to field realities. � Ability to manage simultaneous projects in fast-paced, industrial settings. � Skilled in preparing daily/weekly progress reports, punch lists, and project status updates in formats needed by clients. Software Skill Set: � PLC programming: ? RSLogix 500 / 5000, Studio 5000 (Allen-Bradley / Rockwell Automation) ? TIA Portal, Step 7 (Siemens S7-1200, S7-300, S7-400, S7-1500) ? Unity Pro / Eco Struxure Control Expert (Schneider Electric) ? GX Developer / GX Works2 / GX Works3 (Mitsubishi) etc. � HMI programming (Schneider/Siemens/Allen Bradley). � Electrical Design (Auto CAD Electrical / Eplan / Solidworks Electrical) � Communication and Integration tools (OPC/Modbus/ethernet/Profibus/Profinet) � Simulation and Testing (Schneider/Siemens/Allen Bradley).
